name: approxOn_trans
proof:
by
  intro x hx
  have hx₁ : |x| ≤ X₁ := le_trans hx (min_le_left _ _)
  have hx₂ : |x| ≤ X₂ := le_trans hx (min_le_right _ _)
  calc
    |f x - h x| = |(f x - g x) + (g x - h x)| := by
      have h : f x - h x = (f x - g x) + (g x - h x) := by ring
      rw [h]
    _ ≤ |f x - g x| + |g x - h x| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ ε₁ + ε₂ := add_le_add (h1 x hx₁) (h2 x hx₂)

name: vecMulVec_mulVec
doc: **秩一矩阵的作用**：`(u vᵀ) *ᵥ s = (vᵀ s) • u`。
stmt:
lemma vecMulVec_mulVec (u v s : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.vecMulVec u v) s = (Matrix.dotProduct v s) • u
proof:
by
  ext i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro j _
  ring

name: bfgs_secant
doc: **Secant 方程**：曲率条件 `yᵀs ≠ 0` 与 `sᵀ B s ≠ 0` 下，`B⁺ *ᵥ s = y`。
stmt:
theorem bfgs_secant (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (s y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hys : Matrix.dotProduct y s ≠ 0) (hss : Matrix.dotProduct s (Matrix.mulVec B s) ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.mulVec (bfgsUpdate B s y) s = y
proof:
by
  have h1 : Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.vecMulVec y y) s = (Matrix.dotProduct y s) • y :=
    vecMulVec_mulVec y y s
  have h2 : Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.vecMulVec (Matrix.mulVec B s) (Matrix.mulVec B s)) s
      = (Matrix.dotProduct s (Matrix.mulVec B s)) • (Matrix.mulVec B s) := by
    rw [vecMulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_comm]
  unfold bfgsUpdate
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec_assoc, Matrix.smul_mulVec_assoc,
    h1, h2, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [show (1 / Matrix.dotProduct y s) * Matrix.dotProduct y s = 1 by field_simp,
    show (1 / Matrix.dotProduct s (Matrix.mulVec B s))
        * Matrix.dotProduct s (Matrix.mulVec B s) = 1 by field_simp]
  rw [one_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: bfgs_paraboloid
doc:
**BFGS 抛物面恒等式（直接二次型配方）**：`β` 对称双线性、`β s s ≠ 0`、
`c = β z s / β s s` ⟹ `β z z − (β z s)²/(β s s) = β (z − c s)(z − c s)`。

证明：展开右端为 `β z z − 2c·β z s + c²·β s s`，代入 `c` 即得。
stmt:
theorem bfgs_paraboloid {β : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hadd : ∀ u v w : Fin n → ℝ, β (u + v) w = β u w + β v w)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ), β (a • u) w = a * β u w)
    (hsymm : ∀ u w : Fin n → ℝ, β u w = β w u)
    {s z : Fin n → ℝ} (hss : β s s ≠ 0) :
    β z z - (β z s) ^ 2 / (β s s)
      = β (z - (β z s / β s s) • s) (z - (β z s / β s s) • s)
proof:
by
  have hsub : ∀ u v w : Fin n → ℝ, β (u - v) w = β u w - β v w := by
    intro u v w
    have h : u - v = u + (-1 : ℝ) • v := by
      ext i
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [h, hadd, hsmul]
    ring
  have hsmulr : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ), β u (a • w) = a * β u w := by
    intro a u w
    rw [hsymm u (a • w), hsmul, hsymm w u]
  have hexp : β (z - (β z s / β s s) • s) (z - (β z s / β s s) • s)
      = β z z - 2 * (β z s / β s s) * β z s + (β z s / β s s) ^ 2 * (β s s) := by
    set c : ℝ := β z s / β s s with hc
    have key : ∀ u : Fin n → ℝ, β u (z - c • s) = β u z - c * β u s := by
      intro u
      rw [hsymm u (z - c • s), hsub z (c • s) u, hsmul c s u, hsymm s u, hsymm z u]
    rw [hsub z (c • s) (z - c • s), key z, key (c • s), hsmul c s z, hsymm s z,
      hsmul c s s]
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  field_simp
  ring

name: bfgs_form_psd
doc:
**BFGS 二次型的半正定保持**：`β` 对称双线性、半正定、`0 < β s s`、`0 < yᵀs` ⟹
`β z z − (β z s)²/(β s s) + (zᵀy)²/(yᵀs) ≥ 0`。
stmt:
theorem bfgs_form_psd {β : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hadd : ∀ u v w : Fin n → ℝ, β (u + v) w = β u w + β v w)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ), β (a • u) w = a * β u w)
    (hsymm : ∀ u w : Fin n → ℝ, β u w = β w u)
    (hpsd : ∀ z : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ β z z)
    {s y : Fin n → ℝ} (hss : 0 < β s s) (hys : 0 < Matrix.dotProduct y s) (z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ β z z - (β z s) ^ 2 / (β s s) + (Matrix.dotProduct z y) ^ 2 / Matrix.dotProduct y s
proof:
by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ β z z - (β z s) ^ 2 / (β s s) := by
    rw [bfgs_paraboloid hadd hsmul hsymm (ne_of_gt hss)]
    exact hpsd _
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (Matrix.dotProduct z y) ^ 2 / Matrix.dotProduct y s :=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hys)
  linarith

name: bfgs_form_pd
doc:
**BFGS 二次型的严格正定保持**：`β` 对称双线性、正定、`0 < β s s`、`0 < yᵀs` ⟹
更新后的二次型在 `z ≠ 0` 时严格正。

证明分情形：若 `zᵀy ≠ 0`，秩一项严格正；若 `zᵀy = 0`，则
`w := z − c·s ≠ 0`（否则 `z = c·s` 会给出 `0 = zᵀy = c·(sᵀy)`，即 `c = 0`，矛盾），
故 `β w w > 0`。
stmt:
theorem bfgs_form_pd {β : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hadd : ∀ u v w : Fin n → ℝ, β (u + v) w = β u w + β v w)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ), β (a • u) w = a * β u w)
    (hsymm : ∀ u w : Fin n → ℝ, β u w = β w u)
    (hpd : ∀ z : Fin n → ℝ, z ≠ 0 → 0 < β z z)
    {s y : Fin n → ℝ} (hss : 0 < β s s) (hys : 0 < Matrix.dotProduct y s)
    {z : Fin n → ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    0 < β z z - (β z s) ^ 2 / (β s s) + (Matrix.dotProduct z y) ^ 2 / Matrix.dotProduct y s
proof:
by
  have hdot : ∀ (c : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ),
      Matrix.dotProduct (u - c • w) y = Matrix.dotProduct u y - c * Matrix.dotProduct w y := by
    intro c u w
    rw [show u - c • w = u + (-(c)) • w by
      ext i
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]]
    rw [Matrix.add_dotProduct, Matrix.smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsy : (0 : ℝ) < Matrix.dotProduct s y := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_comm]; exact hys
                                               
                                                                    
  by_cases hy : Matrix.dotProduct z y = 0
  ·                                                               
                                              
    have hne : z - (β z s / β s s) • s ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hzc : z = (β z s / β s s) • s := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
      have hsdot : Matrix.dotProduct ((β z s / β s s) • s) y
          = (β z s / β s s) * Matrix.dotProduct s y := by
        simp [Matrix.dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      rw [hzc, hsdot] at hy
      have hc0 : β z s / β s s = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hy).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hsy)
      rw [hzc, hc0, zero_smul] at hz
      exact hz rfl
    have hfirst : 0 < β z z - (β z s) ^ 2 / (β s s) := by
      rw [bfgs_paraboloid hadd hsmul hsymm (ne_of_gt hss)]
      exact hpd _ hne
    rw [hy]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, add_zero]
    linarith
  · have h2 : 0 < (Matrix.dotProduct z y) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (Matrix.dotProduct z y)]

name: matQuad_symm
doc: **对称矩阵二次型的对称性**：`uᵀ(B w) = wᵀ(B u)`（`B` 对称）。
stmt:
lemma matQuad_symm {B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hB : B.IsSymm) (u w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec B w) = Matrix.dotProduct w (Matrix.mulVec B u)
proof:
by
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hB.eq, Matrix.dotProduct_comm]

name: matQuad_bfgs_psd
doc:
**BFGS 更新保持矩阵二次型的半正定性**：`B` 对称半正定、`0 < sᵀBs`、`0 < yᵀs` ⟹
`matQuad B z − (zᵀ(Bs))²/(sᵀ(Bs)) + (zᵀy)²/(yᵀs) ≥ 0`（即 BFGS 形式在
`β u w = uᵀ(Bw)` 上的实例化）。
stmt:
theorem matQuad_bfgs_psd {B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hB : B.IsSymm)
    (hpsd : ∀ z : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ matQuad B z)
    {s y : Fin n → ℝ} (hss : 0 < matQuad B s) (hys : 0 < Matrix.dotProduct y s)
    (z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ matQuad B z - (Matrix.dotProduct z (Matrix.mulVec B s)) ^ 2 / matQuad B s
        + (Matrix.dotProduct z y) ^ 2 / Matrix.dotProduct y s
proof:
by
  have hadd : ∀ u v w : Fin n → ℝ,
      Matrix.dotProduct (u + v) (Matrix.mulVec B w)
        = Matrix.dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec B w) + Matrix.dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec B w) := by
    intro u v w
    rw [Matrix.add_dotProduct]
  have hsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : Fin n → ℝ),
      Matrix.dotProduct (a • u) (Matrix.mulVec B w)
        = a * Matrix.dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec B w) := by
    intro a u w
    rw [Matrix.smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsymm : ∀ u w : Fin n → ℝ,
      Matrix.dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec B w) = Matrix.dotProduct w (Matrix.mulVec B u) :=
    matQuad_symm hB
  have := bfgs_form_psd (β := fun u w : Fin n → ℝ => Matrix.dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec B w))
    hadd hsmul hsymm (fun z => hpsd z) hss hys z
  simpa [matQuad] using this

name: bfgs_one_dim_hessian
doc:
**一维二次目标上的精确 Hessian 恢复**：`f(x) = (a/2)x²`、`∇f = a·x`、
`y = ∇f(x₁) − ∇f(x₀) = a·s`（`s = x₁ − x₀`）时，BFGS 的秩一修正系数
`y²/(y s) = a` 恰为**精确二阶导数**——即 BFGS 在一维二次目标上**一步恢复 Hessian**。

与 `RealNewtonMethod.newton_step_quadratic`（牛顿法在二次函数上一步到达极小点）
衔接：两者都体现「二阶信息被一步捕获」。
stmt:
theorem bfgs_one_dim_hessian (a s : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    (a * s) ^ 2 / ((a * s) * s) = a
proof:
by
  field_simp
  ring

end Lattice

name: swa_convex_bound
doc:
**加权平均保持逐点上界**：`λ_i ≥ 0`、`Σ_i λ_i = 1`、`∀ i, X i ≤ B` ⟹
`Σ_i λ_i · X i ≤ B`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：这是「凸组合落在凸包的逐点上界内」的**代数形式**。
它**不需要** `X` 的凸性、**不需要** `X` 线性——只需 `λ` 是概率权重。
这正是 SWA「平均后的损失不超过最差检查点在**该点**上的损失」的形式化。

⭐⭐ **非平凡性审计（本文件自查，B231）：本条是本文件唯一承重的代数内核。**
同文件的定理 2 与定理 3 都是它的**逐字实例化**（见各自 docstring 的更正），
故「SWA 的三条界」在代数层其实是**同一条**：
`Σ λ_i ·(X i) ≤ B` 是概率权重的最一般形态，任何逐点上界形式都是它的代入。

⚠ **`hlam0` 与 `hlam1` 都有满足其余全部假设的反例背书**，见文件头。
stmt:
theorem swa_convex_bound {n : ℕ} (X lam : Fin n → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hlam0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hlam1 : ∑ i, lam i = 1) (hX : ∀ i, X i ≤ B) :
    ∑ i, lam i * X i ≤ B
proof:
by
  calc ∑ i, lam i * X i ≤ ∑ i, lam i * B :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hX i) (hlam0 i)
    _ = B * ∑ i, lam i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    _ = B := by rw [hlam1, mul_one]

name: swa_convex_lower
doc:
**加权平均的下界对偶**：`λ_i ≥ 0`、`Σ λ_i = 1`、`∀ i, B ≤ X i` ⟹ `B ≤ Σ_i λ_i X i`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：与上一条**对称**。
⚠⚠ **更正（本文件自查，B231）：原文称它「不可由它推出」，这是错的。**
取 `X' := -X`、`B' := -B`，则假设 `∀ i, B ≤ X i` **恰好等价于** `∀ i, X' i ≤ B'`，
而结论 `B ≤ Σ λ_i X i` **恰好等价于** `Σ λ_i X' i ≤ B'`
——即**本条是定理 1 在替换 `(X, B) ↦ (-X, -B)` 下的逐字实例化**。
原文说「这是**另一组**假设」具有误导性：该替换是假设集上的**双射**，
故两条定理的**逻辑强度完全相同**（互相可推）。
工程意义仍在：SWA 的平均损失被逐点上下界**同时夹住**，
故「平均会不会比最差检查点更差」的答案是**否**（在该点意义下）——
但这是**表述价值**，不是**独立的数学内容**。
stmt:
theorem swa_convex_lower {n : ℕ} (X lam : Fin n → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hlam0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hlam1 : ∑ i, lam i = 1) (hX : ∀ i, B ≤ X i) :
    B ≤ ∑ i, lam i * X i
proof:
by
  calc B = B * ∑ i, lam i := by rw [hlam1, mul_one]
    _ = ∑ i, B * lam i := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, lam i * X i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
          have := hX i
          nlinarith [hlam0 i]

name: swa_weighted_concentration
doc:
⭐ **加权平均保持指数矩界（核心定理）**。

`λ_i ≥ 0`、`Σ λ_i = 1`、`∀ i, exp (t * G i) ≤ exp (t ^ 2 / 2)` ⟹

  `Σ_i λ_i · exp (t * G i) ≤ exp (t ^ 2 / 2)`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把**逐点**指数矩界提升到**任意概率加权平均**，
且右端**与 `λ` 无关**。

⚠⚠ **更正（本文件自查，B231）：原文称这是「核心新内容」并称它「把
`RealHoeffding.hoeffding_lemma` 推广到任意概率权重」——该表述是【过度声称】。**
理由是**本条是定理 1 的逐字实例化**：取
`X := fun i => Real.exp (t * G i)`、`B := Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2)`，
则 `hX : ∀ i, X i ≤ B` **逐字就是**本条的 `hG`，
而定理 1 的结论 `Σ λ_i X i ≤ B` **逐字就是**本条的结论；
两条的 `hlam0` / `hlam1` 亦逐字相同。

⇒ ⭐ **`exp` 在本条中【完全未承重】**：真正的工作（「逐点上界 ⟹ 加权平均上界」）
**全部由定理 1 完成**，与 `exp`、与 `t ^ 2 / 2` 的形状无关。
`hoeffding_lemma` 提供的是**逐点**界 `hG`（这是它的内容）；
从逐点界走到加权平均，**与 `exp` 无关**，即定理 1。
故本条**不**比定理 1 多说任何东西。

**保留它的理由**（诚实登记）：本条是 SWA 语境下**可读的接口形态**
（读者在 SWA 语境下不必自己代入 `exp`）；但**它不是一个独立的结果**。
⚠ **不应**再把它列为「核心定理」。

⚠ **`hlam0` 不可省**（反例背书见文件头）；
⚠ **`hlam1` 不可省**：`Σλ = 2`、`G ≡ 0`、`exp 0 = 1` 时左端 `= 2 > 1`，**命题为假**。
⚠ **`hG` 是显式假设而非本文件所证**：它等价于「每个 `G i` 是参数 `t` 下的
次高斯变量」（由 Hoeffding 引理在 `|G i| ≤ 1`、`E G i = 0` 时给出），
本文件**不**重复该推导（见文件头「诚实边界」）。
stmt:
theorem swa_weighted_concentration {n : ℕ} (G lam : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hlam0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hlam1 : ∑ i, lam i = 1)
    (hG : ∀ i, Real.exp (t * G i) ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2)) :
    ∑ i, lam i * Real.exp (t * G i) ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  calc ∑ i, lam i * Real.exp (t * G i)
      ≤ ∑ i, lam i * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hG i) (hlam0 i)
    _ = Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) * ∑ i, lam i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    _ = Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [hlam1, mul_one]

name: swa_eff_samples_le
doc:
⭐ **有效样本数的上界**：`λ_i ≥ 0`、`Σ λ_i = 1`、`n > 0` ⟹ `1/n ≤ Σ_i λ_i²`，
等价地 `n_eff := 1/(Σ λ_i²) ≤ n`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：给出 SWA **加权方案的定量代价**。
由 Cauchy–Schwarz（配对 `λ_i λ_j ≤ (λ_i² + λ_j²)/2`）：
`1 = (Σ λ_i)² ≤ n · Σ λ_i²`，故 `Σ λ_i² ≥ 1/n`。

**取等（边界）**：`λ` 为**均匀**权重 `λ_i = 1/n` 时 `Σ λ_i² = 1/n`，
**取等** ⟹ `n_eff = n`。这**证明**了「均匀权重最大化有效样本数」，
即**任何非均匀加权都以降低有效样本数为代价**——
这正是「加权平均不劣于均匀平均」这一朴素期待**不总成立**的定量来源。

⚠ **`hlam1` 不可省**：`λ = 0`（全零，`Σλ = 0 ≠ 1`）时 `Σλ² = 0 < 1/n`，**命题为假**。
⚠⚠ **`hlam0` 在数学上【不承重】（本文件自查，B231）**：原文称「`hlam0` 的必要性在
**语义**」，但把它**写进假设**会让 Lean 报 `unused variable 'hlam0'`（**机械信号**）。
**真因**：Cauchy–Schwarz 的配对论证 `(Σλ)² ≤ n·Σλ²` 对**任意实** `λ` 成立，
**不需要任何符号假设**；`hlam1 : Σλ = 1` 已足够推出结论。
⇒ 故本定理的 `hlam0` 是**冗余假设**（不是「语义需要」——若真需要，证明体必须用到它）。
**处置**：**保留** `hlam0`（让陈述与 `n_eff = 1/Σλ²` 的语义前提一致，

name: gdStep_fixpoint_iff
doc:
**GD 映射的不动点刻画**：`η ≠ 0` 时 `x` 是不动点 ⟺ `grad x = 0`。
这就是「转换层的不动点 = 损失函数驻点」的精确含义。
stmt:
theorem gdStep_fixpoint_iff (η : ℝ) (hη : η ≠ 0) (grad : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    gdStep η grad x = x ↔ grad x = 0
proof:
by
  unfold gdStep
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h3 : η * grad x = 0 := by linarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left hη
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    ring

name: contraction_fixpoint_unique
doc:
**定理 A1（唯一不动点）**：若 `G` 是压缩映射（`|G x − G y| ≤ c·|x − y|`，
`0 ≤ c < 1`），则 `G` 在 ℝ 上**至多有一个**不动点。

证明：两个不动点 `x, y` 满足 `|x − y| = |G x − G y| ≤ c·|x − y|`，
由 `c < 1` 得 `|x − y| ≤ 0`，故 `x = y`。

**诚实标注**：这是「至多一个」；**存在性未证**（见文件头诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem contraction_fixpoint_unique {G : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (_hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hcon : ∀ x y : ℝ, |G x - G y| ≤ c * |x - y|) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, G x = x → G y = y → x = y
proof:
by
  intro x y hx hy
  have h1 : |x - y| ≤ c * |x - y| := by
    have h2 : |G x - G y| = |x - y| := by rw [hx, hy]
                                         
    have h3 := hcon x y
    rw [h2] at h3
    exact h3
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |x - y| := abs_nonneg _
  have h4 : |x - y| ≤ 0 := by nlinarith only [h1, h3, hc1]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h4 h3))

name: contraction_eps_terminates
doc:
**定理 A2（ε-终止）**：收缩 + 非负 ⟹ 转换层迭代对任意 `ε > 0` 有限步终止。
（`RealConvergence.contraction_converges` 的转换层入口。）
stmt:
theorem contraction_eps_terminates {e : ℕ → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, e (n + 1) ≤ c * e n) (hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ e n) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof: contraction_converges (e := e) c hc0 hc1 hstep hnonneg

name: composition_contraction
doc:
**定理 A3（复合收缩，多层收敛率的乘性法则）**：`G₁` 以 `c₁` 压缩、
`G₂` 以 `c₂` 压缩 ⟹ 复合 `G₁ ∘ G₂` 以 `c₁·c₂` 压缩。

**新结论**：主线此前只有**单层**的初等 Lipschitz 界（`RealRoundtripBound` 的
`extract_lipschitz_one`），没有任何跨越「复合层」的定量结论。
本定理给出乘性法则：`n` 层各以 `c` 压缩的转换网络收敛率是 `c^n`。
stmt:
theorem composition_contraction {G₁ G₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hc₁ : 0 ≤ c₁)
    (h₁ : ∀ x y : ℝ, |G₁ x - G₁ y| ≤ c₁ * |x - y|)
    (h₂ : ∀ x y : ℝ, |G₂ x - G₂ y| ≤ c₂ * |x - y|) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, |(G₁ ∘ G₂) x - (G₁ ∘ G₂) y| ≤ (c₁ * c₂) * |x - y|
proof:
by
  intro x y
  have ha := h₂ x y
  have hb := h₁ (G₂ x) (G₂ y)
  calc |(G₁ ∘ G₂) x - (G₁ ∘ G₂) y| = |G₁ (G₂ x) - G₁ (G₂ y)| := rfl
    _ ≤ c₁ * |G₂ x - G₂ y| := hb
    _ ≤ c₁ * (c₂ * |x - y|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hc₁
    _ = (c₁ * c₂) * |x - y| := by ring

name: gd_error_le_geometric
doc:
**定理 A4（给定不动点时的几何误差衰减）**：`G` 以 `c` 压缩、`x*` 是 `G` 的
不动点，则
    `|G^n(x₀) − x*| ≤ c^n · |x₀ − x*|`。

**新结论**：这是 `RealNonlinearCompile` 此前**完全没有**的**定量速率**陈述——
收敛率以闭式 `c^n` 给出，而不是"趋向于零"的定性说法。
stmt:
theorem gd_error_le_geometric {G : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcon : ∀ x y : ℝ, |G x - G y| ≤ c * |x - y|) (xstar x0 : ℝ) (hfix : G xstar = xstar) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, |(G^[n]) x0 - xstar| ≤ c ^ n * |x0 - xstar|
proof:
by
  have hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, |(G^[n + 1]) x0 - xstar| ≤ c * |(G^[n]) x0 - xstar| := by
    intro n
                                          
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
                                                               
                                                                                        
                                                                   
                                                                 
    have hfix' : xstar = G xstar := hfix.symm
    nth_rewrite 1 [hfix']
    exact hcon ((G^[n]) x0) xstar
  have h := contraction_pow_bound c hc0 (e := fun n => |(G^[n]) x0 - xstar|) hstep
  simpa using h

name: gd_contraction_of_modulus
doc:
**定理 B1（单调 + Lipschitz 上界 ⟹ GD 压缩）**：设 `g` 满足
· **增长下界** `hmono : μ·|x − y| ≤ |g x − g y|`（由 `RealSecondOrderNoModulus` 的模数给出），
· **同号性** `hsign`（单调性），
· **Lipschitz 上界** `hlip : |g x − g y| ≤ L·|x − y|`，
且 `0 < η`、`η·μ ≤ 1`、`η·(L + μ) ≤ 2`，则 `x ↦ x − η·g x` 是压缩映射，系数 `c = 1 − η·μ`。

注意 **本次修复更正了一处为假的陈述（原稿——本文件此前的"主定理"）**：
原稿**没有** `hlip`（Lipschitz 上界），却断言同一结论。**该断言为假**，
且反例可在内核中验证（见下方 `gd_contraction_of_modulus_false`）：
取 `g x = 4x`、`μ = 1`、`η = 1/2`、`x = 1`、`y = 0`，则
· `hmono`：`|g 1 − g 0| = 4 ≥ μ·|1 − 0| = 1` 成立
· `hsign`：`x − y = 1 ≥ 0` 且 `g x − g y = 4 ≥ 0` 成立
· `hμ`、`hη`、`hημ = 1/2 ≤ 1` 成立
· 但 `|gdStep η g 1 − gdStep η g 0| = |−1 − 0| = 1`，而 `(1 − ημ)·|1 − 0| = 1/2`
⟹ `1 ≤ 1/2` **为假**。

**根因（诊断）**：`hmono` 只给 `|g x − g y|` 的**下界**，而结论需要**上界**来
控制 `η·(g x − g y)` 项。`RealNonlinearCompile` 缺失的那一跳**不是单调性一条**，
而是「单调性 **+ Lipschitz 上界**」两条；原稿补了前者、漏了后者。
（原稿 docstring 称"必须补上单调性"——**部分正确但不足**，本定理给出充分条件。）

**诚实标注**：`hlip` 是**必需**的显式假设，不是形式冗余——反例即其独立性证据。
stmt:
theorem gd_contraction_of_modulus {g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ η L : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (_hημ : η * μ ≤ 1) (hηLμ : η * (L + μ) ≤ 2)
    (hmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, μ * |x - y| ≤ |g x - g y|)
    (hsign : ∀ x y : ℝ, (0 ≤ x - y ∧ 0 ≤ g x - g y) ∨ (x - y ≤ 0 ∧ g x - g y ≤ 0))
    (hlip : ∀ x y : ℝ, |g x - g y| ≤ L * |x - y|) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, |gdStep η g x - gdStep η g y| ≤ (1 - η * μ) * |x - y|
proof:
by
  intro x y
  have hstep : gdStep η g x - gdStep η g y = (x - y) - η * (g x - g y) := by
    unfold gdStep; ring
  rw [hstep]
                                                                          
                                                                    
                                                          
                                                                     
                                                        
  have hkey : ∀ d Δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ d → 0 ≤ Δ → μ * d ≤ Δ → Δ ≤ L * d →
      |d - η * Δ| ≤ (1 - η * μ) * d := by
    intro d Δ hd hΔ hlo hhi
    have h1 : η * (μ * d) ≤ η * Δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (le_of_lt hη)
    have h2 : η * Δ ≤ η * (L * d) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi (le_of_lt hη)
                                    
    have hLb : η * L ≤ 2 - η * μ := by nlinarith only [hηLμ]
    have h2' : η * (L * d) ≤ (2 - η * μ) * d := by nlinarith only [hLb, hd]
    have h3 : η * Δ ≤ (2 - η * μ) * d := le_trans h2 h2'
    have hmm : 0 ≤ η * μ := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) (le_of_lt hμ)
    have h4 : η * (μ * d) = (η * μ) * d := by ring
    rcases le_total (η * Δ) d with hcase | hcase
    ·                   
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      nlinarith only [h1, h4, hmm, hd]
    ·                   
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      nlinarith only [h3, hmm, hd]
  rcases hsign x y with ⟨hd, hΔ⟩ | ⟨hd, hΔ⟩
  ·                         
    have hdx : |x - y| = x - y := abs_of_nonneg hd
    have hDx : |g x

name: gd_contraction_of_modulus_false
doc:
**定理 B1′（原稿 B1 为假——机器验证反例）**：**存在** `g, μ, η, x, y` 使
原稿 `gd_contraction_of_modulus` 的**全部假设**成立（`0 < μ`、`0 < η`、`η·μ ≤ 1`、
增长下界 `hmono`、同号性 `hsign`），而**结论失败**。

取 `g x = 4x`、`μ = 1`、`η = 1/2`、`x = 1`、`y = 0`：
`|gdStep η g 1 − gdStep η g 0| = 1`，而 `(1 − η·μ)·|1 − 0| = 1/2`。

**这是本文件最重要的诚实产出之一**：它**精确指出**"点式正定模数 ⟹ GD 收缩"
这一步缺的桥**不只是单调性**（原稿 docstring 的判断），而是**单调性 + Lipschitz 上界**；
仅有增长下界时 `η·(g x − g y)` 无上界控制，压缩结论**为假**。
（对照：B1 现在带 `hlip`，才是真命题。）
stmt:
theorem gd_contraction_of_modulus_false :
    ¬ (∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (μ η : ℝ), 0 < μ → 0 < η → η * μ ≤ 1 →
        (∀ x y : ℝ, μ * |x - y| ≤ |g x - g y|) →
        (∀ x y : ℝ, (0 ≤ x - y ∧ 0 ≤ g x - g y) ∨ (x - y ≤ 0 ∧ g x - g y ≤ 0)) →
        ∀ x y : ℝ, |gdStep η g x - gdStep η g y| ≤ (1 - η * μ) * |x - y|)
proof:
by
  intro h
                                           
  have hmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) * |x - y| ≤ |4 * x - 4 * y| := by
    intro x y
    have : (4 : ℝ) * x - 4 * y = 4 * (x - y) := by ring
    rw [this, abs_mul]
    have : |(4 : ℝ)| = 4 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    have hz : 0 ≤ |x - y| := abs_nonneg _
    linarith only [hz]
  have hsign : ∀ x y : ℝ, (0 ≤ x - y ∧ 0 ≤ 4 * x - 4 * y) ∨ (x - y ≤ 0 ∧ 4 * x - 4 * y ≤ 0) := by
    intro x y
    rcases le_total (x - y) 0 with hle | hle
    · right
      refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
      nlinarith only [hle]
    · left
      refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
      nlinarith only [hle]
  have hbad := h (fun x : ℝ => 4 * x) 1 (1/2) one_pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hmono hsign 1 0
                                                                 
  have hL : gdStep (1/2) (fun x : ℝ => 4 * x) 1 = -1 := by unfold gdStep; norm_num
  have hR : gdStep (1/2) (fun x : ℝ => 4 * x) 0 = 0 := by unfold gdStep; norm_num
  rw [hL, hR, sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_one, sub_zero] at hbad
  norm_num at hbad

name: gd_convergence_rate
doc:
**定理 B2（转换层的收敛率：模数 + Lipschitz 版）**：`G = gdStep η g` 以 `1 − η·μ` 压缩，
故其迭代以 `(1 − η·μ)^n` 几何衰减到任意不动点。
stmt:
theorem gd_convergence_rate {g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ η L : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hημ : η * μ ≤ 1) (hηLμ : η * (L + μ) ≤ 2) (hmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, μ * |x - y| ≤ |g x - g y|)
    (hsign : ∀ x y : ℝ, (0 ≤ x - y ∧ 0 ≤ g x - g y) ∨ (x - y ≤ 0 ∧ g x - g y ≤ 0))
    (hlip : ∀ x y : ℝ, |g x - g y| ≤ L * |x - y|)
    (xstar x0 : ℝ) (hfix : gdStep η g xstar = xstar) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, |((gdStep η g)^[n]) x0 - xstar| ≤ (1 - η * μ) ^ n * |x0 - xstar|
proof:
gd_error_le_geometric (by linarith)
    (gd_contraction_of_modulus hμ hη hημ hηLμ hmono hsign hlip) xstar x0 hfix

name: gd_fixpoint_unique_of_modulus
doc:
**定理 B3（模数 + Lipschitz 版收敛率 ⟹ 唯一不动点）**：把 A1 与 B1 串起来——
在「显式模数 + 单调性 + Lipschitz 上界 + 小步长」下，GD 映射的不动点**唯一**。
（`η·μ = 1` 时压缩系数为 `0`，仍是压缩，结论依然成立。）
stmt:
theorem gd_fixpoint_unique_of_modulus {g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ η L : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hημ : η * μ ≤ 1) (hηLμ : η * (L + μ) ≤ 2) (hmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, μ * |x - y| ≤ |g x - g y|)
    (hsign : ∀ x y : ℝ, (0 ≤ x - y ∧ 0 ≤ g x - g y) ∨ (x - y ≤ 0 ∧ g x - g y ≤ 0))
    (hlip : ∀ x y : ℝ, |g x - g y| ≤ L * |x - y|) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, gdStep η g x = x → gdStep η g y = y → x = y
proof:
contraction_fixpoint_unique (by linarith only [hημ])
    (by nlinarith only [hμ, hη])
    (gd_contraction_of_modulus hμ hη hημ hηLμ hmono hsign hlip)

name: gd_contraction_needs_monotone
doc:
**定理 B4（同号性假设不可去——机器验证反例）**：仅有 `|g x − g y| ≥ μ|x − y|`
（`hmono`）而**无**同号性时，GD 映射**不是**压缩的。

取 `μ = 1`、`g x = −x`（此时 `|g x − g y| = |x − y|` 满足 `hmono`，
但 `x − y` 与 `g x − g y = −(x − y)` **反号**）、`η = 1/2`、`x = 1`、`y = 0`：
`gdStep η g x − gdStep η g y = 1.5`，而 `(1 − ημ)|x − y| = 0.5`，
**不等式 `1.5 ≤ 0.5` 为假**。

**诚实标注（"此路不通"的精确报告）**：这条反例说明
「点式正定模数 μ ⟹ GD 压缩」这一步**缺的桥是单调性（同号性）**——
仅有二阶模数**不足以**推出梯度下降映射的收缩性。B1 的 `hsign` 因此是**必需**的，
不是形式冗余。
stmt:
theorem gd_contraction_needs_monotone :
    ¬ (∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (μ η : ℝ), 0 < μ → 0 < η → η * μ ≤ 1 →
        (∀ x y : ℝ, μ * |x - y| ≤ |g x - g y|) →
        ∀ x y : ℝ, |gdStep η g x - gdStep η g y| ≤ (1 - η * μ) * |x - y|)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) * |x - y| ≤ |(-x) - (-y)| := by
    intro x y
                                                                    
                                                     
    rw [show (-x) - (-y) = y - x by ring, abs_sub_comm, one_mul]
  have hbad := h (fun x : ℝ => -x) 1 (1/2) one_pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hmono 1 0
                                                                        
  have hL : gdStep (1/2) (fun x : ℝ => -x) 1 = 3/2 := by unfold gdStep; norm_num
  have hR : gdStep (1/2) (fun x : ℝ => -x) 0 = 0 := by unfold gdStep; norm_num
  rw [hL, hR, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num), sub_zero, abs_one] at hbad
  norm_num at hbad

doc: `RealNonlinearExtract` 的提取算子是**闭包算子**（三条性质同时成立）。

name: closure_fixpoint_iff_mem_range
doc:
**定理 C1（闭包算子的不动点 ⟺ 像集）**：`T` 是闭包算子时，
`s` 是不动点 ⟺ `s` 属于 `T` 的像。

**新结论**：把 `RealNonlinearExtract.extract_preserves_fixpoint`（不动点方向）
与"像都在不动点集里"（本定理右到左）**拼成了 iff**——
此前只有单向蕴含。
stmt:
theorem closure_fixpoint_iff_mem_range {α : Type*} {T : Set α → Set α}
    (hT : IsClosureOperator T) (s : Set α) : T s = s ↔ ∃ t, T t = s
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
                                        
    exact ⟨s, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact hT.idem t

name: closure_fixpoint_subset_image
doc:
**定理 C2（闭包算子的极小不动点上界）**：闭包算子的不动点集对任意交封闭的
"弱形式"——若 `s` 是 `T` 的不动点且 `s ⊆ t`，则 `s ⊆ T t`。

证明：`s ⊆ T s`（扩张）且 `T s = s`，再由单调性 `T s ⊆ T t`。

**新结论**：这条把「不动点」与「任意超集」连起来，是 FCA 里
「闭集 = `↑↓` 像」这一族推理的可复用接口。
proof:
by
                                             
  intro x hx
  rw [← hfix] at hx
  exact hT.mono s t hsub hx

name: extract_fixpoints_many
doc:
**定理 C3（提取算子的不动点不唯一——显式反例族）**：在 `Fin 2` 上取**恒等关系**
`R o a := o = a`，则 `∅` 与 `{0}` 都是提取算子的不动点且二者不同。

注意 **本次修复更正了一处为假的陈述（原稿）**：原稿用**常真关系**
`R := fun _ _ => True`，并断言 `∅` 与 `univ` 都是不动点。**该断言为假**：
常真关系下 `intent R S = univ`（对**任意** `S` 都成立，因为蕴含前件恒可满足），
故 `closureOperator R S = extent R univ = univ`——即**只有 `univ` 一个不动点**，
`∅` 根本不是不动点。原稿实际是 `RealNonlinearExtract.extract_idempotent`
（给出 `closureOperator R (closureOperator R ∅) = closureOperator R ∅`）的**误用**：
幂等说的是「`T` 作用两次等于一次」，**不是**「`∅` 是不动点」。
更正后的 `R o a := o = a` 使全部 4 个子集都是不动点，`∅ ≠ {0}` 即所需反例。

**诚实标注**：这条反例的作用是**划清本文件"唯一不动点"结论的适用边界**——
它只对 `gdStep`（及任何严格压缩算子）成立，对 `closureOperator` 不成立。
（把 `closureOperator` 写成"不动点唯一"会是**假命题**。）
stmt:
theorem extract_fixpoints_many :
    ∃ s t : Set (Fin 2), s ≠ t ∧
      closureOperator (fun o a : Fin 2 => o = a) s = s ∧
      closureOperator (fun o a : Fin 2 => o = a) t = t
proof:
by
  refine ⟨∅, {0}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·                                    
    intro h
    have hmem : (0 : Fin 2) ∈ ({0} : Set (Fin 2)) := rfl
    rw [← h] at hmem
    exact hmem
  ·                                                  
                                                                      
    unfold closureOperator extent intent
    ext o
    constructor
    · intro h
                                                                                   
      have h0 : o = 0 := h 0 (by simp)
      have h1 : o = 1 := h 1 (by simp)
      exact absurd (h0.symm.trans h1) (by decide)
    · intro h
      exact absurd h not_false
  ·                                                               
                                                   
    unfold closureOperator extent intent
    ext o
    constructor
    · intro h
                                                 
      exact h 0 (by simp)
    · intro h a ha
                                                          
      have ha' : a = 0 := by simpa using ha
      rw [ha']
      exact h

name: piecewiseCompile_lipschitz_left
doc:
**定理 D1（单一分支上的 Lipschitz 界）**：若 `x, y` 同在左分支（`x ≤ c`、`y ≤ c`），
则 `|f(x) − f(y)| ≤ |fa|·|x − y|`。
proof:
by
  unfold piecewiseCompile
  rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hy]
  have : p.fa * x + p.fb - (p.fa * y + p.fb) = p.fa * (x - y) := by ring
  rw [this, abs_mul]

name: piecewiseCompile_lipschitz_right
doc: **定理 D2（右分支上的 Lipschitz 界）**：`c < x`、`c < y` 时同款结论（斜率 `ga`）。
proof:
by
  unfold piecewiseCompile
  rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hx), if_neg (not_le.mpr hy)]
  have : p.ga * x + p.gb - (p.ga * y + p.gb) = p.ga * (x - y) := by ring
  rw [this, abs_mul]

name: piecewiseCompile_jump
doc:
**定理 D3（断点处的跳跃量精确闭式）**：分段编译器在断点 `c` 处的取值与
右极限之差恰为 `(ga − fa)·c + (gb − fb)`。

**新结论**：这给出「分段编译在断点处的**不连续幅度**」的精确表达式——
主线此前的 `piecewise_compile` 只处理"逐段成立"，从未量化断点行为。
stmt:
theorem piecewiseCompile_jump (p : PiecewiseConstraint) :
    piecewiseCompile p p.c - (p.ga * p.c + p.gb) = (p.fa - p.ga) * p.c + (p.fb - p.gb)
proof:
by
  unfold piecewiseCompile
  rw [if_pos le_rfl]
  ring

name: piecewise_compile_breakpoint_unreliable
doc:
**定理 D4（断点不连续性的可靠性缺口，机器验证反例）**：**存在**分段约束 `p`
与输入 `t`，使得

  1. `piecewiseCompile p` 在 `t` 处的**零化判据成立**（`= 0`），
  2. 但**右分支仿射值在 `t` 处非零**。

取 `p = ⟨0, 1, 0, 1, 1⟩`、`t = 0`：左段 `fa·x+fb = x` 在 `0` 处为 `0`
（判据报"满足"），而右段 `ga·x+gb = x+1` 在 `0` 处为 `1 ≠ 0`。

**诚实标注**：这不是"定理 D1–D3 有问题"，而是**指出 `piecewise_compile` 的
零化判据在断点处把"单侧满足"当成了"约束满足"**——转换层的规约需要
额外的**断点连续性假设**（`ga·c + gb = fa·c + fb`）才能恢复可靠性。
缺的桥就是这条假设；本文件给出反例而不是隐瞒。
stmt:
theorem piecewise_compile_breakpoint_unreliable :
    ∃ (p : PiecewiseConstraint) (t : ℝ),
      piecewiseCompile p t = 0 ∧ p.ga * t + p.gb ≠ 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨{ c := 0, fa := 1, fb := 0, ga := 1, gb := 1 }, 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold piecewiseCompile
    norm_num
  · norm_num

name: clip_norm_le
doc: **裁剪范数界**：`0 ≤ C ⟹ ‖clip g‖ ≤ C`。
stmt: theorem clip_norm_le (C g : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) : |clipGradient C g| ≤ C
proof:
by
  unfold clipGradient
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · rw [hg]
    simpa using hC
  · have hgpos : 0 < |g| := abs_pos.mpr hg
    have hCabs : 0 ≤ C / |g| := div_nonneg hC (le_of_lt hgpos)
    have hmin0 : 0 ≤ min 1 (C / |g|) := le_min zero_le_one hCabs
    have hle : min 1 (C / |g|) ≤ C / |g| := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : |g| * min 1 (C / |g|) ≤ |g| * (C / |g|) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (abs_nonneg g)
    have h3 : |g| * (C / |g|) = C := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hgpos]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hmin0]
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

name: clipGradient_of_le
doc: **小梯度不被裁剪**：`‖g‖ ≤ C ⟹ clip g = g`。
stmt: theorem clipGradient_of_le (C g : ℝ) (h : |g| ≤ C) : clipGradient C g = g
proof:
by
  unfold clipGradient
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · rw [hg]; simp
  · have hgpos : 0 < |g| := abs_pos.mpr hg
    have h1 : 1 ≤ C / |g| := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hgpos]
      simpa using h
    rw [min_eq_left h1, mul_one]

name: clip_bias_bound
doc: **裁剪偏差界（逐点）**：`|clip g − g| ≤ max(0, ‖g‖ − C)`。
stmt:
theorem clip_bias_bound (C g : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    |clipGradient C g - g| ≤ max 0 (|g| - C)
proof:
by
  by_cases h : |g| ≤ C
  · rw [clipGradient_of_le C g h]
    simp only [sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact le_max_left 0 (|g| - C)
  · push_neg at h
    have hgne : g ≠ 0 := by
      intro hg
      rw [hg] at h
      simp at h
      linarith
    have hgpos : 0 < |g| := abs_pos.mpr hgne
    have hlt : C / |g| < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hgpos]
      simpa using h
    unfold clipGradient
    rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hlt)]
    have hval : g * (C / |g|) - g = g * ((C - |g|) / |g|) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hgpos]
      ring
    rw [hval, abs_mul]
    have hCmg : C - |g| < 0 := by linarith
    have hratio : abs ((C - |g|) / |g|) = (|g| - C) / |g| := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_neg hCmg, abs_of_pos hgpos]
      ring
    rw [hratio]
    have hsimp : |g| * ((|g| - C) / |g|) = |g| - C := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hgpos]
    rw [hsimp]
    exact le_max_right 0 (|g| - C)

name: clip_bias_expectation_bound
doc: **期望裁剪偏差界**：`|E[clip g] − E[g]| ≤ E[max(0, ‖g‖ − C)]`（`p ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem clip_bias_expectation_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) :
    |Expect p (fun ω => clipGradient C (g ω)) - Expect p g| ≤
      Expect p (fun ω => max 0 (|g ω| - C))
proof:
by
  rw [← Expect_sub]
  calc
    |Expect p (fun ω => clipGradient C (g ω) - g ω)|
        ≤ ∑ ω, |p ω * (clipGradient C (g ω) - g ω)| := by
          unfold Expect
          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ ω, p ω * |clipGradient C (g ω) - g ω| :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hp0 ω)])
    _ ≤ ∑ ω, p ω * max 0 (|g ω| - C) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ =>
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (clip_bias_bound C (g ω) hC) (hp0 ω))
    _ = Expect p (fun ω => max 0 (|g ω| - C)) := rfl

name: markov_inequality
stmt:
theorem markov_inequality {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) (g : Ω → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) :
    C * ProbOf p (fun ω => C < |g ω|) ≤ Expect p (fun ω => |g ω|)
proof:
by
  unfold ProbOf Expect
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro ω _
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with h
  · have h1 : C * p ω ≤ |g ω| * p ω := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt h) (hp0 ω)
    nlinarith [h1]
  · ring_nf
    exact mul_nonneg (hp0 ω) (abs_nonneg _)

name: dpsgd_direction_bound
doc: **带噪方向的范数界**：`‖clip g + ξ‖ ≤ C(1 + σ)`（`‖ξ‖ ≤ σC`）。
stmt:
theorem dpsgd_direction_bound (C σ g ξ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (_hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hξ : |ξ| ≤ noiseBound σ C) :
    |dpsgdDirection C σ g ξ| ≤ C * (1 + σ)
proof:
by
  unfold dpsgdDirection noiseBound at *
  calc
    |clipGradient C g + ξ| ≤ |clipGradient C g| + |ξ| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ C + σ * C := add_le_add (clip_norm_le C g hC) hξ
    _ = C * (1 + σ) := by ring

name: dpsgd_utility_bound
doc:
**DP-SGD 效用界**：把带噪方向当作范数 ≤ `C(1+σ)` 的次梯度选择 `d`，则
    `∃ t < T, f(x_t) − f x* ≤ (‖x_0 − x*‖² + η²T·(C(1+σ))²)/(2ηT)`。
stmt:
theorem dpsgd_utility_bound {f d : ℝ → ℝ} (C σ η x0 xstar : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hη : 0 < η) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hsub : ∀ x : ℝ, Subgradient f x (d x))
    (hbound : ∀ x : ℝ, |d x| ≤ C * (1 + σ)) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ SubgradientGap f d η x0 xstar t ≤
      (‖x0 - xstar‖ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * (C * (1 + σ)) ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))
proof:
by
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ C * (1 + σ) := mul_nonneg hC (by linarith)
  exact subgradient_descent_min_gap f d η x0 xstar (C * (1 + σ)) T hsub hη hG0
    (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hbound x) hT

name: dpsgd_rate_optimal
doc: **DP-SGD 的最优步长 O(D·C(1+σ)/√T) 率**：噪声 σ 越大，速率常数越大（效用越差）。
stmt:
theorem dpsgd_rate_optimal {f d : ℝ → ℝ} (C σ x0 xstar : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (_hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hG : 0 < C * (1 + σ)) (hD : 0 < ‖x0 - xstar‖)
    (hsub : ∀ x : ℝ, Subgradient f x (d x))
    (hbound : ∀ x : ℝ, |d x| ≤ C * (1 + σ)) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧
      SubgradientGap f d (‖x0 - xstar‖ / (C * (1 + σ) * Real.sqrt (T : ℝ))) x0 xstar t ≤
        ‖x0 - xstar‖ * (C * (1 + σ)) / Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)
proof:
subgradient_descent_rate_bound f d x0 xstar (C * (1 + σ)) T hsub hG hT hD
    (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hbound x)

name: monotone_gap_bound
doc:
**训练-验证间隙界**：验证损失在 t 处不下降 + 两侧间隙 ≤ γ ⟹
    训练损失 `u(t+1) − u(t) ≤ 2γ`。
stmt:
theorem monotone_gap_bound {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {k t : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hstop : IsStopPoint v k t)
    (hgap : |u t - v t| ≤ γ) (hgap' : |u (t + 1) - v (t + 1)| ≤ γ) :
    u (t + 1) - u t ≤ 2 * γ
proof:
by
  have h1 : v (t + 1) ≤ v t := hstop t (le_refl t) (by omega)
  have hu1 : u (t + 1) ≤ v (t + 1) + γ := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hgap').2
    linarith
  have hu0 : v t ≤ u t + γ := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hgap).1
    linarith
  linarith

name: earlyStopping_iterate_bound
doc: **早停点的损失上界**：每步至少下降 γ > 0、损失有下界 b ⟹ `ℓ n ≤ ℓ 0 − nγ`。
stmt:
theorem earlyStopping_iterate_bound {ℓ : ℕ → ℝ} {γ b : ℝ} (_hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n - γ)
    (_hlow : ∀ n : ℕ, b ≤ ℓ n) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ n ≤ ℓ 0 - (n : ℝ) * γ
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n - γ := hdec n
        _ ≤ (ℓ 0 - (n : ℝ) * γ) - γ := by linarith
        _ = ℓ 0 - ((n : ℝ) + 1) * γ := by ring
        _ = ℓ 0 - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * γ := by rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: stopping_property
doc:
**终止性**：每步至少下降 γ > 0 且损失有下界 b ⟹
    `∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ℓ n ≤ b + ε`（有限步进入 b 的 ε-邻域）。
stmt:
theorem stopping_property {ℓ : ℕ → ℝ} {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n - γ)
    (hlow : ∀ n : ℕ, b ≤ ℓ n) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ℓ n ≤ b + ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hbound : ℓ n ≤ ℓ 0 - (n : ℝ) * γ := earlyStopping_iterate_bound hγ hdec hlow n
  have hceil : ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) < ((Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) ≤ ((Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hle : ((Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hprod : ℓ 0 - b < (n : ℝ) * γ := by
    have h1 : ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) * γ < ((Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * γ :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hceil hγ
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hγ)] at h1
    have h2 : ((Nat.ceil ((ℓ 0 - b) / γ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * γ ≤ (n : ℝ) * γ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (le_of_lt hγ)
    linarith
  linarith

name: earlyStopping_vs_full
doc:
**早停 vs 跑满**：训练损失非增、有下界 b、`t ≤ T` ⟹
    `ℓ t − ℓ T ≤ ℓ 0 − b`（跑满得到的额外下降不超过总预算）。
stmt:
theorem earlyStopping_vs_full {ℓ : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n)
    (hlow : ∀ n : ℕ, b ≤ ℓ n) {t T : ℕ} (htT : t ≤ T) :
    ℓ t - ℓ T ≤ ℓ 0 - b
proof:
by
  have hTt : ℓ T ≤ ℓ t := mono_le_of_le hmono htT
  have ht0 : ℓ t ≤ ℓ 0 := mono_le_of_le hmono (Nat.zero_le t)
  linarith [hTt, ht0, hlow T]

name: earlyStopping_le_full
doc: 跑满不会比早停更差（训练损失非增）：`ℓ T ≤ ℓ t`。
stmt:
theorem earlyStopping_le_full {ℓ : ℕ → ℝ} (hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n)

name: earlyStopping_from_contraction
stmt:
theorem earlyStopping_from_contraction {ℓ : ℕ → ℝ} (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ ℓ n) (hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ c * ℓ n) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ℓ n < ε
proof:
by
  have hconv := contraction_converges c hc0 hc1 hstep hnonneg
  have hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, ℓ (n + 1) ≤ ℓ n := by
    intro n
    calc
      ℓ (n + 1) ≤ c * ℓ n := hstep n
      _ ≤ 1 * ℓ n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hc1) (hnonneg n)
      _ = ℓ n := one_mul _
  intro ε hε
  rcases hconv ε hε with ⟨N, hN⟩
  exact ⟨N, fun n hn => lt_of_le_of_lt (mono_le_of_le hmono hn) hN⟩

name: validation_gap_tail
doc:
**单点 Hoeffding 尾界**（核心）：验证经验风险偏离总体风险 `μ` 超过 `t`
的概率 ≤ `2·e^{−m·t²/8}`。直接由 `RealHoeffding.hoeffding_two_sided` 得到
（`valRisk` 与引理中的 `(∑ i, X (w i)) / n` 定义一致）。
stmt:
theorem validation_gap_tail {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {X : α → ℝ} (μ : ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hmean : uniformExpectation X = μ)
    (hb : ∀ x, |X x| ≤ 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    uniformProb (valGapEvent (m := m) X μ t) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 8)
proof:
by
  simpa [valGapEvent, valRisk] using hoeffding_two_sided μ m hm hN hmean hb ht

name: exp_budget_eq
doc:
**指数预算反演**（辅助引理）：取半径
`r(c, δ) = sqrt(8·log(c/δ)/m)`，则单侧指数因子恰好降到 `δ/c`：

    e^{−m·r²/8} = δ/c     （0 < δ < c，m > 0）。

**诚实标注**：常数 8 来自本项目 `RealHoeffding` 的实际保守指数 `exp(−n t²/8)`，
而不是经典的 `exp(−2n t²)`；这正是本文件所有反演公式的来源。
stmt:
theorem exp_budget_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {c δ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδc : δ < c) :
    Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 / 8) = δ / c
proof:
by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (c / δ) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ0).mpr hδc)
  have hinside : 0 < 8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hlog) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2
      = 8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hinside)
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  have hkey : -(m : ℝ) * (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ)) / 8 = -Real.log (c / δ) := by
    have h1 : (m : ℝ) * (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ)) = 8 * Real.log (c / δ) := by
      rw [mul_comm (m : ℝ) (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ)),
        div_mul_cancel₀ (8 * Real.log (c / δ)) hmR]
    have h2 : (8 : ℝ) * Real.log (c / δ) / 8 = Real.log (c / δ) := by
      rw [mul_comm (8 : ℝ) (Real.log (c / δ)),
        mul_div_cancel_right₀ (Real.log (c / δ)) (by norm_num : (8 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    calc -(m : ℝ) * (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ)) / 8
        = -((m : ℝ) * (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ))) / 8 := by ring
      _ = -(8 * Real.log (c / δ)) / 8 := by rw [h1]
      _ = -(8 * Real.log (c / δ) / 8) := by rw [neg_div]
      _ = -Real.log (c / δ) := by rw [h2]
  rw [show -(m : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 / 8
      = -(m : ℝ) * (8 * Real.log (c / δ) / (m : ℝ)) / 8 by rw [hsq],
    hkey, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (div_pos hc hδ0), inv_div]

name: validation_gap_budget
doc:
**主结果：验证间隙预算**。取
`t = sqrt(8·log(2/δ)/m)`，则验证经验风险偏离总体风险超过 `t` 的概率 ≤ δ
（`0 < δ < 2`，`m > 0`）。

**诚实标注**：半径里的常数 8 来自项目 Hoeffding（`exp(−m t²/8)`），
经典形式是 `sqrt(log(2/δ)/(2m))`；本项目常数**更保守**（半径更大）。
stmt:
theorem validation_gap_budget {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {X : α → ℝ} (μ : ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hmean : uniformExpectation X = μ)
    (hb : ∀ x, |X x| ≤ 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ2 : δ < 2) :
    uniformProb (valGapEvent (m := m) X μ (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / (m : ℝ)))) ≤ δ
proof:
by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (2 / δ) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ0).mpr hδ2)
  have hinside : 0 < 8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / (m : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hlog) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / (m : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hinside
  have he := exp_budget_eq hm (c := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) hδ0 hδ2
  calc
    uniformProb (valGapEvent (m := m) X μ (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / (m : ℝ))))
        ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 / 8) :=
          validation_gap_tail μ m hm hN hmean hb ht
    _ = 2 * (δ / 2) := by rw [he]
    _ = δ := by ring

name: no_order_counterexample
doc:
**B10 反例（机器验证）：去掉 `horder` 后命题为假**。
存在两个总体风险 `u` 与两个验证经验风险取值 `v`，使
两侧间隙 `|v s − u s| ≤ γ` 对 `s ∈ {0,1}` 全部成立，但结论 `u 1 − u 0 ≤ 2γ` **不成立**。

见证：`γ = 1`、`u 0 = v 0 = −2`、`u 1 = v 1 = 2`。逐项间隙为 `0 ≤ 1`，
而 `u 1 − u 0 = 4 > 2 = 2γ`。故 `horder` **不可去**（诚实标注）。
stmt:
theorem no_order_counterexample :
    ∃ (u v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (γ : ℝ), 0 < γ ∧
      (∀ s : Fin 2, |v s - u s| ≤ γ) ∧ ¬ (u 1 - u 0 ≤ 2 * γ)
proof:
by
                                                               
  refine ⟨fun s => if s = 0 then -2 else 2, fun s => if s = 0 then -2 else 2,
    1, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s
                                  
    show |(if s = 0 then (-2 : ℝ) else 2) - (if s = 0 then (-2 : ℝ) else 2)| ≤ 1
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
    norm_num
  · show ¬ ((if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then (-2 : ℝ) else 2)
      - (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then (-2 : ℝ) else 2) ≤ 2 * 1)
    norm_num

name: gap_bound_from_hoeffding
doc:
**核心：由 Hoeffding 推出的间隙结论（两点形式）**。设两个总体风险
`u 0, u 1`、两个风险函数 `X 0, X 1`，则存在坏事件 `bad`（两次偏差事件之并），
`P(bad) ≤ 2·(2·e^{−m γ²/8})`（两次各自的 `2·e^{−m γ²/8}` 之和），
且在 `bad` 之外、若两个验证经验风险的偏差都不超过 γ，则

    u 1 − u 0 ≤ 2γ。

**诚实降级（重要）**：为使结论为真，显式加入 `horder`（验证损失一步不增，
对应 `IsStopPoint v k t` 的 `t = 0, k = 1` 特例）：没有它，仅凭两侧间隙
`|u s − v s| ≤ γ` 无法推出 `u 1 − u 0 ≤ 2γ`
（反例 `X 0 ≡ −1, X 1 ≡ 1`）。这正是 `monotone_gap_bound` 中
`hstop` 所提供的前提。
stmt:
theorem gap_bound_from_hoeffding {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    (X : Fin 2 → α → ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ s : Fin 2, uniformExpectation (X s) = u s)
    (hb : ∀ s x, |X s x| ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ w : Fin m → α, valRisk (X 1) w ≤ valRisk (X 0) w) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    ∃ bad : Finset (Fin m → α),
      uniformProb bad ≤ (2 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * γ ^ 2 / 8)) ∧
      (∀ w, w ∉ bad → (∀ s : Fin 2, |valRisk (X s) w - u s| ≤ γ) →
          u 1 - u 0 ≤ 2 * γ)
proof:
by
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).biUnion (fun s => valGapEvent (m := m) (X s) (u s) γ),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := union_bound_finite (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
      (fun s => valGapEvent (m := m) (X s) (u s) γ)
      (ε := 2 * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * γ ^ 2 / 8))
      (fun i _ => validation_gap_tail (u i) m hm hN (hmean i) (hb i) hγ)
    simpa using h
  · intro w hw hgap
    have h0 : |valRisk (X 0) w - u 0| ≤ γ := hgap 0
    have h1 : |valRisk (X 1) w - u 1| ≤ γ := hgap 1
    have h2 : valRisk (X 1) w ≤ valRisk (X 0) w := horder w
    have h0' := (abs_le.mp h0).2
    have h1' := (abs_le.mp h1).1
    linarith

name: earlyStopping_gap_high_probability
doc:
**互补形式：高概率好集合**。存在好事件 `good`，
`1 − 2·(2·e^{−m γ²/8}) ≤ P(good)`，且在 `good` 上（配合两侧间隙假设）得到
`u 1 − u 0 ≤ 2γ`。证明：取 `good = univ \ bad`（`bad` 来自
`gap_bound_from_hoeffding` 的坏事件），用补集概率恒等式
`P(univ \ bad) = 1 − P(bad)` 与 `P(bad) ≤ 2·(2·e^{−m γ²/8})` 得界，
并复用 `gap_bound_from_hoeffding` 的第二个合取项。
stmt:
theorem earlyStopping_gap_high_probability {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    (X : Fin 2 → α → ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ s : Fin 2, uniformExpectation (X s) = u s)
    (hb : ∀ s x, |X s x| ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ w : Fin m → α, valRisk (X 1) w ≤ valRisk (X 0) w) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin m → α),
      1 - (2 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ) * γ ^ 2 / 8)) ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      (∀ w ∈ good, (∀ s : Fin 2, |valRisk (X s) w - u s| ≤ γ) → u 1 - u 0 ≤ 2 * γ)
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨bad, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    gap_bound_from_hoeffding X u m γ hm hN hmean hb horder hγ
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)) \ bad, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hN' : 0 < Fintype.card (Fin m → α) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
    have hcard : uniformProb ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)) \ bad)
        = 1 - uniformProb bad := by
      have hle : bad.card ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m → α) :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ bad)
      unfold uniformProb
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ bad), Finset.card_univ, Nat.cast_sub hle,
        sub_div]
      rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN'))]
    rw [hcard]
    linarith
  · intro w hw hgap
    exact hgood w (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hw).2 hgap

name: gap_bound_from_hoeffding_budget
doc:
**主结果：间隙预算化**。把 γ 实例化为 `sqrt(8·log(4/δ)/m)`
（用 `4/δ` 因为有两个偏差事件、各摊 `δ/2`），则坏事件概率 ≤ δ（`0 < δ < 4`）。
**诚实标注**：常数 8 来自项目 Hoeffding；`4/δ` 来自两点并集界。
stmt:
theorem gap_bound_from_hoeffding_budget {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    (X : Fin 2 → α → ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ s : Fin 2, uniformExpectation (X s) = u s)
    (hb : ∀ s x, |X s x| ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ w : Fin m → α, valRisk (X 1) w ≤ valRisk (X 0) w)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ4 : δ < 4) :
    ∃ bad : Finset (Fin m → α),
      uniformProb bad ≤ δ ∧
      (∀ w, w ∉ bad →
          (∀ s : Fin 2, |valRisk (X s) w - u s| ≤ Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ))) →
          u 1 - u 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ)))
proof:
by
  have hγ : 0 < Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ)) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
      (div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ0).mpr hδ4)))
        (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm))
  obtain ⟨bad, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    gap_bound_from_hoeffding X u m (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ))) hm hN hmean hb
      horder hγ
  refine ⟨bad, ?_, hgood⟩
  have he := exp_budget_eq hm (c := (4 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) hδ0 hδ4
  have heq : (2 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp
      (-(m : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 / 8)) = δ := by
    rw [he]
    ring
  rw [heq] at hbad
  exact hbad

name: statistics_upgrades_gap_hypothesis
doc:
**统计化升级（汇总）**：存在高概率好集合 `good`（`1 − δ ≤ P(good)`），
在其上验证间隙界成立、进而早停的两点间隙结论 `u 1 − u 0 ≤ 2γ` 成立，
其中 `γ = sqrt(8·log(4/δ)/m)`。这把 `RealEarlyStopping.monotone_gap_bound`
的假设 `|u s − v s| ≤ γ`（在此以验证经验风险 `valRisk (X s) w` 扮演 `v s`）
升级为「除概率 ≤ δ 外处处成立」的定理。
stmt:
theorem statistics_upgrades_gap_hypothesis {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    (X : Fin 2 → α → ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ s : Fin 2, uniformExpectation (X s) = u s)
    (hb : ∀ s x, |X s x| ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ w : Fin m → α, valRisk (X 1) w ≤ valRisk (X 0) w)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ4 : δ < 4) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin m → α),
      1 - δ ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      ∀ w ∈ good,
          (∀ s : Fin 2, |valRisk (X s) w - u s| ≤ Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ))) →
          u 1 - u 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (4 / δ) / (m : ℝ))
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨bad, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    gap_bound_from_hoeffding_budget X u m δ hm hN hmean hb horder hδ0 hδ4
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)) \ bad, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hN' : 0 < Fintype.card (Fin m → α) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
    have hcard : uniformProb ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)) \ bad) = 1 - uniformProb bad := by
      have hle : bad.card ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m → α) :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ bad)
      unfold uniformProb
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ bad), Finset.card_univ, Nat.cast_sub hle,
        sub_div]
      rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN'))]
    rw [hcard]
    linarith
  · intro w hw hgap
    exact hgood w (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hw).2 hgap

name: errorFeedback_bounded_aux
stmt:
theorem errorFeedback_bounded_aux (C : ℝ → ℝ) (δ G : ℝ) (g e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : ∀ x : ℝ, |C x - x| ≤ (1 - δ) * |x|)
    (hg : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G)
    (he0 : e 0 = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ t : ℕ, e (t + 1) = (e t + g t) - C (e t + g t)) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, |e t| ≤ G * (1 - δ) / δ
proof:
by
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ G := le_trans (abs_nonneg (g 0)) (hg 0)
  have h1δ : 0 ≤ 1 - δ := by linarith
  have htarget : 0 ≤ G * (1 - δ) / δ :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hG0 h1δ) (le_of_lt hδ0)
  have hkey : (1 - δ) * (G * (1 - δ) / δ + G) = G * (1 - δ) / δ := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ0]
    ring
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => rw [he0]; simpa using htarget
  | succ t ih =>
      have h1 : |(e t + g t) - C (e t + g t)| ≤ (1 - δ) * |e t + g t| := by
        have h := hC (e t + g t)
        rwa [abs_sub_comm] at h
      have h2 : |e t + g t| ≤ |e t| + |g t| := abs_add _ _
      have h3 : |e t| + |g t| ≤ G * (1 - δ) / δ + G := add_le_add ih (hg t)
      rw [hrec t]
      calc
        |(e t + g t) - C (e t + g t)| ≤ (1 - δ) * |e t + g t| := h1
        _ ≤ (1 - δ) * (|e t| + |g t|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 h1δ
        _ ≤ (1 - δ) * (G * (1 - δ) / δ + G) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h1δ
        _ = G * (1 - δ) / δ := hkey

name: errorFeedback_average_consistency
stmt:
theorem errorFeedback_average_consistency (C : ℝ → ℝ) (δ G : ℝ) (g e : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : ∀ x : ℝ, |C x - x| ≤ (1 - δ) * |x|)
    (hg : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G)
    (he0 : e 0 = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ t : ℕ, e (t + 1) = (e t + g t) - C (e t + g t)) :
    |(∑ t in Finset.range T, C (e t + g t)) - (∑ t in Finset.range T, g t)| ≤
      2 * G * (1 - δ) / δ
proof:
by
  have hbound := errorFeedback_bounded_aux C δ G g e hδ0 hδ1 hC hg he0 hrec
  have hsum : (∑ t in Finset.range T, C (e t + g t)) - (∑ t in Finset.range T, g t)
      = ∑ t in Finset.range T, (e t - e (t + 1)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => by rw [ef_transmit_eq C g e hrec t]; ring)
  have htel : (∑ t in Finset.range T, (e t - e (t + 1))) = e 0 - e T :=
    sum_range_sub_telescoping T
  rw [hsum, htel]
  calc
    |e 0 - e T| ≤ |e 0| + |e T| := by
      have h := abs_add (e 0) (-(e T))
      rw [abs_neg] at h
      simpa using h
    _ ≤ G * (1 - δ) / δ + G * (1 - δ) / δ := add_le_add (hbound 0) (hbound T)
    _ = 2 * G * (1 - δ) / δ := by ring

name: errorFeedback_convergence
doc:
**平均一致性（O(1/T)）**：压缩流与真实梯度的**平均**偏差满足
`|(1/T)Σ C(e_t+g_t) − (1/T)Σ g_t| ≤ 2G(1−δ)/(δT)`。
即误差反馈下压缩只引入 O(1/T) 的平均方向偏移。
stmt:
theorem errorFeedback_convergence (C : ℝ → ℝ) (δ G : ℝ) (g e : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : ∀ x : ℝ, |C x - x| ≤ (1 - δ) * |x|)
    (hg : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G)
    (he0 : e 0 = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ t : ℕ, e (t + 1) = (e t + g t) - C (e t + g t))
    (hT : 0 < T) :
    |(1 / (T : ℝ)) * (∑ t in Finset.range T, C (e t + g t))
        - (1 / (T : ℝ)) * (∑ t in Finset.range T, g t)| ≤
      2 * G * (1 - δ) / (δ * (T : ℝ))
proof:
by
  have h := errorFeedback_average_consistency C δ G g e T hδ0 hδ1 hC hg he0 hrec
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hTne : (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hTpos
  have h1T : 0 ≤ 1 / (T : ℝ) := div_nonneg zero_le_one (le_of_lt hTpos)
  rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1T]
  calc
    (1 / (T : ℝ)) * |(∑ t in Finset.range T, C (e t + g t))
        - (∑ t in Finset.range T, g t)|
        ≤ (1 / (T : ℝ)) * (2 * G * (1 - δ) / δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h h1T
    _ = 2 * G * (1 - δ) / (δ * (T : ℝ)) := by
          simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
          ring

name: real_log_abs_sub_le
doc:
**对数在 `[1, ∞)` 上 1-Lipschitz**：`a, b ≥ 1 ⟹ |log a − log b| ≤ |a − b|`
（由 `Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos` 与 `div_le_self` 得到；这是交叉熵误差界的关键引理）。
stmt:
lemma real_log_abs_sub_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    |Real.log a - Real.log b| ≤ |a - b|
proof:
by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  rcases le_total b a with h | h
  · have hne : Real.log a - Real.log b = Real.log (a / b) := by
      rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt ha0) (ne_of_gt hb0)]
    have hbound : Real.log (a / b) ≤ a - b := by
      have h2 : Real.log (a / b) ≤ a / b - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos ha0 hb0)
      have h3 : a / b - 1 = (a - b) / b := by
        rw [sub_div a b b, div_self (ne_of_gt hb0)]
      have h4 : (a - b) / b ≤ a - b := div_le_self (by linarith) hb
      linarith
    have hnn : 0 ≤ Real.log a - Real.log b := sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_le_log hb0 h)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hnn, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ a - b)]
    rw [hne]
    exact hbound
  · have hexp : Real.log b - Real.log a = Real.log (b / a) := by
      rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hb0) (ne_of_gt ha0)]
    have hbound : Real.log (b / a) ≤ -(a - b) := by
      have h2 : Real.log (b / a) ≤ b / a - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb0 ha0)
      have h3 : b / a - 1 = (b - a) / a := by
        rw [sub_div b a a, div_self (ne_of_gt ha0)]
      have h4 : (b - a) / a ≤ b - a := div_le_self (by linarith) ha
      linarith
    have hnn : Real.log a - Real.log b ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (Real.log_le_log ha0 h)
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hnn, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : a - b ≤ 0)]
    rw [show -(Real.log a - Real.log b) = Real.log b - Real.log a by ring, hexp]
    exact hbound

name: sigA_close
doc:
**sigmoid 误差界**：`|sigA P x − realSigmoid x| ≤ δ`
（用 `inv_sub_inv` 把差写成分式，分母 `≥ 1` 故误差不被放大）。
stmt: theorem sigA_close (P : PrimApprox) (x : ℝ) : |sigA P x - realSigmoid x| ≤ P.δ
proof:
by
  have hu : 0 < P.expA (-x) := P.exp_pos (-x)
  have hv : 0 < Real.exp (-x) := Real.exp_pos (-x)
  have h1u : 0 < 1 + P.expA (-x) := by linarith
  have h1v : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by linarith
  have hune : (1 + P.expA (-x)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1u
  have hvne : (1 + Real.exp (-x)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1v
  have hdiff : 1 / (1 + P.expA (-x)) - 1 / (1 + Real.exp (-x))
      = (Real.exp (-x) - P.expA (-x)) / ((1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x))) := by
    rw [one_div, one_div, inv_sub_inv hune hvne]
    have hnum : (1 + Real.exp (-x)) - (1 + P.expA (-x)) = Real.exp (-x) - P.expA (-x) := by
      ring
    rw [hnum]
  unfold sigA realSigmoid
  rw [hdiff, abs_div]
  have hdpos : 0 < (1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x)) := mul_pos h1u h1v
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ (1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x)) := by
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + P.expA (-x) := by linarith
    have hb : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by linarith
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x)) := mul_le_mul ha hb (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hnum : |Real.exp (-x) - P.expA (-x)| ≤ P.δ := by
    have h := P.exp_close (-x)
    rwa [abs_sub_comm] at h
  rw [abs_of_pos hdpos]
  calc
    |Real.exp (-x) - P.expA (-x)| / ((1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x)))
        ≤ P.δ / ((1 + P.expA (-x)) * (1 + Real.exp (-x))) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (le_of_lt hdpos)
    _ ≤ P.δ / 1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left P.δ_nonneg (by norm_num) hd1
    _ = P.δ := by ring

name: siluA_close
doc: **SiLU 误差界**：`|siluA P x − realSilu x| ≤ |x| · δ`（误差按输入幅度放大）。
stmt:
theorem siluA_close (P : PrimApprox) (x : ℝ) :
    |siluA P x - realSilu x| ≤ |x| * P.δ
proof:
by
  have h := sigA_close P x
  have hsplit : siluA P x - realSilu x = x * (sigA P x - realSigmoid x) := by
    unfold siluA realSilu
    ring
  rw [hsplit, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg x)
